preconditions.description: The number of elements in permutation p must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain exactly n distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(q) == n and all(1 <= q[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and all(q[q[i]] == p[i] for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation q exists, output -1; otherwise, output a permutation q such that q^2 equals p.
